mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WISHLIST ( WISH_NO, USER_ID, PRODUCT_NO, CDATETIME ) VALUES ( SEQ_WISH_NO.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{productNo}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT P.*, NVL(IMG.IMAGE_URL, '/resources/img/no-image.png') AS imagePath, SI.BUSINESS_NAME AS sellerName FROM PRODUCT P JOIN WISHLIST w ON P.PRODUCT_NO = w.PRODUCT_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_URL FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY NVL(SORT_ORDER, 9999), IMAGE_ID ) AS RN FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE UPPER(TRIM(IS_THUMBNAIL)) = 'Y' ) WHERE RN = 1 ) IMG ON P.PRODUCT_NO = IMG.PRODUCT_NO
LEFT JOIN USERS U ON P.SELLER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SELLER_INFO SI ON U.USER_ID = SI.USER_ID
WHERE w.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY w.CDATETIME DESC
